integrity: Complete reproduction via verify.py and census.csv; exact integer Smith forms and two independent uncollapsed witness chain reductions.
scientific_limitations: Finite exhaustive classification: 3<=n<=15, nonempty binary supports of at most five chips on consistently directed cycles. No statement on larger cycles, larger chip budgets, or integral homotopy type. Smith forms computed with an open-source library; independent mathematical review has not been performed. Broad general torsion existence in avalanche homology is covered by a September 2026 tree-realization result, not claimed here.
title: A sharp torsion threshold for five-chip avalanche complexes on directed cycles
